items.title: 63475_Arnett Cobb oral history interview
items.q: The interviewee (Arnett Cobb) does not mention Tim Gales. Tim Gales is mentioned by the interviewer as one of the people who came to hear the group, but the interviewee's response does not confirm any personal interaction or relationship with him.

ctx.x: And I got away from it. And the results of this, now, let me get into it. I played in the [White] Zanzibar in Philadelphia. Gale Agency called over. Lou Leslie was the guy -- about putting in a group in the [WHITE] Zanzibar. So Dick told them, said, "Man, we got the best attraction we could have in here. We don't need nobody now." He I said, "Who do you have?" He said, "We got Arnett Cobb from Lionel Hampton's band. He's packing them in." Say, "He is?" I'm just going to work for two weeks, and I'm going to rest…

Do you know that night they was there? Ralph Cooper, Lou Leslie and Tim Gales come in to hear what he was talking about on the telephone. And when he come in and heard the group, they asked him could -- on intermission -- could we take the group over to one of them halls on Broad Street because he had a band sound in there, and they permitted it. And we went over there.
They had drums and all that set up, where you didn't have to take no instrument other than your horn, you know.
